{{Top}}
A '''hurricane''' was a large weather system characterized by spiraling clouds.<ref name="exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>

Many compared the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar's]] [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']] to a hurricane on account of its "blast-cluster" attack capability, in which the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] appeared to be moving in every direction at once.<ref name="outridertoy">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Dash Rendar's ''Outrider''|link=soteKoutrider.asp}}</ref> An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] was named the [[Hurricane (Strike-class)|''Hurricane'']].<ref name="xwa">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
